title: The brothers, and the parents' marriage
summary: He was close to the youngest and the next-older brother; the eldest helped raise them; his mother had a hard time with his father.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Fancy that. Which of the brothers were you close with? Any of them?
Yeah, the little one. And the one next to me. The one was three years older than me.
The other, oldest one, he was gone all the time.
He was that much older than you.
He helped to raise us too.
Yeah. Oh, the oldest one did?
Oh, you mean he helped to bring home some money, too, you mean? Or just to look out for you.
Well, your mother and dad, they got along nicely together? Or did she have a little bit of a hard time with your father?
No. She had a hard time with him.
He said he was gone all the time.
Yeah. And if he was a gambling man --
-- I guess -- well, at least she didn't have to see when he blew everything.
